digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler field contract and property testing
propositions: Reconciler parity bugs escape because field asymmetry policy is scattered across code with no single declarative source of truth for field symmetry classes (bidirectional-roundtrip, add-wins, one-way-with-propagation-gate).
A new declarative registry module _field_contract.py enumerates reconciled fields with their symmetry class and codec/gate references, making the field contract enumerable and enforceable.

Property tests parameterized off the registry validate that declared field symmetry classes match actual code behavior (roundtrip identity, add-wins idempotence, gate consultation) through real call paths.
A coverage guard in test collection fails build if a field handled by inbound_differ or apply_inbound_records lacks a registry entry, preventing undeclared fields from evading property validation.
The registry declaration and property tests remain additive; no call-site rewiring or transport refactoring occurs (typed transport work landed separately as cc77).
